entries.name: bind
entries.type: {α β : Type u} → List α → (α → List β) → List β

entries.name: map_const
entries.type: {α β : Type u} → (Functor.mapConst : α → List β → List α) = Functor.map ∘ Function.const β

entries.name: id_map
entries.type: {α : Type u} → (xs : List α) → id <$> xs = xs

entries.name: seqLeft_eq
entries.type: {α β : Type u} → (x : List α) → (y : List β) → x <* y = Function.const β <$> x <*> y

entries.name: seqRight_eq
entries.type: {α β : Type u} → (x : List α) → (y : List β) → x *> y = Function.const α id <$> x <*> y

entries.name: pure_seq
entries.type: {α β : Type u} → (g : α → β) → (x : List α) → pure g <*> x = g <$> x

entries.name: bind_pure_comp
entries.type: {α β : Type u} → (f : α → β) → (x : List α) → x >>= (fun a => pure (f a)) = f <$> x

entries.name: bind_map
entries.type: {α β : Type u} → (f : List (α → β)) → (x : List α) → f >>= (. <$> x) = f <*> x

entries.name: pure_bind
entries.type: {α β : Type u} → (x : α) → (f : α → List β) → pure x >>= f = f x

entries.name: bind_assoc
entries.type: {α β γ : Type u} → (x : List α) → (f : α → List β) → (g : β → List γ) → x >>= f >>= g = x >>= fun a => f a >>= g

scope_coverage: All public/literal binders, instance field binders, both generalized IHs, finite producer and inversion packets, lambda/intro/case fields. No named-application pseudo-binders.
proof_only_classical: Permitted for finite membership and simplification; no added instance or public premise.
